user_profiles_verified_phone_exists.name: user_profiles_verified_phone_exists
user_profiles_verified_phone_exists.value: "user_profiles"."phone_verified_at" IS NULL OR "user_profiles"."phone" IS NOT NULL

facility_memberships_joined_consistent.name: facility_memberships_joined_consistent
facility_memberships_joined_consistent.value: ("facility_memberships"."status" <> 'ACTIVE' OR "facility_memberships"."joined_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("facility_memberships"."status" <> 'INVITED' OR "facility_memberships"."joined_at" IS NULL)

facility_verifications_review_recorded.name: facility_verifications_review_recorded
facility_verifications_review_recorded.value: "facility_verifications"."status" NOT IN ('VERIFIED', 'REJECTED') OR ("facility_verifications"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "facility_verifications"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

donation_history_verification_recorded.name: donation_history_verification_recorded
donation_history_verification_recorded.value:
("donation_history"."verification_status" = 'UNVERIFIED' AND "donation_history"."verified_by" IS NULL AND "donation_history"."verified_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("donation_history"."verification_status" <> 'UNVERIFIED' AND "donation_history"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL AND "donation_history"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)

donor_eligibility_calc_outcome_shape.name: donor_eligibility_calc_outcome_shape
donor_eligibility_calc_outcome_shape.value:
("donor_eligibility_calculations"."outcome" = 'COMPUTED' AND "donor_eligibility_calculations"."source_donation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "donor_eligibility_calculations"."source_donated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "donor_eligibility_calculations"."rule_id" IS NOT NULL
            AND "donor_eligibility_calculations"."interval_days_used" IS NOT NULL AND "donor_eligibility_calculations"."rule_scope_used" IS NOT NULL AND "donor_eligibility_calculations"."rule_effective_from" IS NOT NULL
            AND "donor_eligibility_calculations"."rule_source_note" IS NOT NULL AND "donor_eligibility_calculations"."next_eligible_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("donor_eligibility_calculations"."outcome" = 'NO_RULE' AND "donor_eligibility_calculations"."source_donation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "donor_eligibility_calculations"."source_donated_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "donor_eligibility_calculations"."rule_id" IS NULL AND "donor_eligibility_calculations"."next_eligible_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("donor_eligibility_calculations"."outcome" = 'NO_DONATION' AND "donor_eligibility_calculations"."source_donation_id" IS NULL AND "donor_eligibility_calculations"."rule_id" IS NULL AND "donor_eligibility_calculations"."next_eligible_at" IS NULL)

donor_verifications_review_recorded.name: donor_verifications_review_recorded
donor_verifications_review_recorded.value: "donor_verifications"."status" NOT IN ('VERIFIED', 'REJECTED') OR ("donor_verifications"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "donor_verifications"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

blood_requests_open_expiry_idx.name: blood_requests_open_expiry_idx
blood_requests_open_expiry_idx.where: "blood_requests"."status" NOT IN ('FULFILLED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED', 'REJECTED') AND "blood_requests"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL

blood_unit_events_transfer_facilities.name: blood_unit_events_transfer_facilities
blood_unit_events_transfer_facilities.value: "blood_unit_events"."event" <> 'TRANSFERRED' OR ("blood_unit_events"."from_facility_id" IS NOT NULL AND "blood_unit_events"."to_facility_id" IS NOT NULL AND "blood_unit_events"."from_facility_id" <> "blood_unit_events"."to_facility_id")

blood_unit_events_request_required.name: blood_unit_events_request_required
blood_unit_events_request_required.value: "blood_unit_events"."event" NOT IN ('RESERVED', 'RELEASED', 'ISSUED') OR "blood_unit_events"."request_id" IS NOT NULL

donor_matches_batch_by_status.name: donor_matches_batch_by_status
donor_matches_batch_by_status.value:
("donor_matches"."status" IN ('CANDIDATE', 'EXCLUDED') AND "donor_matches"."batch_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("donor_matches"."status" NOT IN ('CANDIDATE', 'EXCLUDED') AND "donor_matches"."batch_id" IS NOT NULL AND "donor_matches"."notified_at" IS NOT NULL)

donor_matches_consent_needs_batch.name: donor_matches_consent_needs_batch
donor_matches_consent_needs_batch.value: "donor_matches"."location_consent_at" IS NULL OR "donor_matches"."batch_id" IS NOT NULL

donor_matches_reason_code_format.name: donor_matches_reason_code_format
donor_matches_reason_code_format.value: ("donor_matches"."exclusion_reason" IS NULL OR "donor_matches"."exclusion_reason" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$') AND ("donor_matches"."drop_reason" IS NULL OR "donor_matches"."drop_reason" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$')

donor_matches_distance_eta_non_negative.name: donor_matches_distance_eta_non_negative
donor_matches_distance_eta_non_negative.value: ("donor_matches"."distance_km" IS NULL OR "donor_matches"."distance_km" >= 0) AND ("donor_matches"."eta_minutes" IS NULL OR "donor_matches"."eta_minutes" >= 0)

ml_model_versions_activation_recorded.name: ml_model_versions_activation_recorded
ml_model_versions_activation_recorded.value: "ml_model_versions"."status" = 'CANDIDATE' OR ("ml_model_versions"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ml_model_versions"."activated_by" IS NOT NULL)

audit_logs_entity_needs_type.name: audit_logs_entity_needs_type
audit_logs_entity_needs_type.value: "audit_logs"."entity_id" IS NULL OR "audit_logs"."entity_type" IS NOT NULL
